blocks.x: In addition to the comprehensive forms of ziyarah, this chapter comprises supplicatory prayers that follow the forms of ziyarah as well as invocations of Almighty Allah’s blessings upon the Infallibles. This chapter thus consists of several parts as follows:

The comprehensive forms of ziyarah stand for these formulas that can be said at visiting any of the Holy Imams, peace be upon them. Although there are many such comprehensive forms, let us mention only some of them.
